description_en: Calls the BackFill operation to backfill data for a task flow
description_zh: 调用BackFill接口，给任务编排补数据
name: BackFill

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.
You can find the tenant ID by hovering over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task flow. You can obtain this parameter by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 任务流ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of start node IDs for data backfill.

If this parameter is not specified, the entire task flow is run
parameters.help_zh:
补数据开始节点ID列表。

参数缺省时运行整个任务流
parameters.name: start_node_ids

parameters.help_en: The filter condition. Specifies the list of node IDs in the task flow that do not require data backfill
parameters.help_zh: 过滤条件，指定任务流中无需补数据的节点Id列表
parameters.name: filter_node_ids

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to run downstream nodes. Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 是否运行下游节点。缺省时默认为true
parameters.name: is_trigger_sub_tree

parameters.help_en: The business time for data backfill. This parameter is required when you backfill data for a specified date
parameters.help_zh: 补数据业务时间。指定时间补数据需要填写该参数
parameters.name: back_fill_date

parameters.help_en: The start business time for data backfill. This parameter is required when you backfill data for a specified date range
parameters.help_zh: 补数据开始业务时间。指定时间范围补数据需要填写该参数
parameters.name: back_fill_date_begin

parameters.help_en: The end business time for data backfill. This parameter is required when you backfill data for a specified date range
parameters.help_zh: 补数据结束业务时间。指定时间范围补数据需要填写该参数
parameters.name: back_fill_date_end

parameters.help_en: The data timestamp interval for data backfill. Unit: hours. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 24
parameters.help_zh: 补数据时间间隔，单位：小时。最小值：1，默认值：24
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The execution order of the data backfill task flow. Valid values:
0: descending order. Runs from the latest date to the earliest date.
1: default value. Ascending order. Runs from the earliest date to the latest date
parameters.help_zh:
补数据任务流运行顺序。取值：
0：降序。从大日期到小日期。
1：默认值，升序。从小日期到大日期
parameters.name: asc

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the historical task flow.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically retrieves the ID of the most recently published task flow version. If no task flow has been published, the system cannot retrieve the task flow version ID, and the call fails
parameters.help_zh:
历史任务流ID。

若您未填写该参数，在调用API时，系统会自动获取最近发布的任务流版本ID作为该参数的值。若没有发布过任务流，系统获取不到任务流版本ID，则调用会出错
parameters.name: history_dag_id

DagInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the task flow execution record. You can obtain this parameter by calling the [ListTaskFlowInstance]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424689.html） operation
DagInstanceId.description_zh: 任务流运行记录ID，可通过调用接口[ListTaskFlowInstance]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424689.html）获取该参数的值

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
